newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Roly buys U.S. decorative products firm.
newsitem.headline: Roly buys U.S. decorative products firm.

text.p: Home decor and consumer products company Roly International Holdings Ltd said on Monday it had entered a US$2.9 million share purchase agreement to acquire 80 percent of Connecticut-based Sun Hill Industries, Inc.

Sun Hill designs, manufactures and distributes products used during seasonal holidays and the acquisition would add an estimated 20 percent increase in sales to Roly's seasonal products business, the company said in a statement.
Seasonal products constituted one-fifth of group turnover of US$238.3 million in the last financial year, it said.
Sun Hill is expected to contribute an additional US$14 million to group turnover and profit before minority interests of US$660,000 for the financial year ending April 30, 1998.
The acquisition will be funded through internal means with payment made in three stages between financial years 1997 and 1999.
